description: Implemented the requested deterministic 165-second annealing experiment in `solver.py`: - 48 restarts from the SimpleTES seed - Exact sum/difference scoring - Add, delete, and replacement mutations - Seed `5` - Exponential cooling from `0.01` to `1e-6` - Atomic checkpoint and final writes Syntax validated without running the solver. `PROPOSAL.md` was omitted because the final constraint permits changes only to `solver.py`.

metadata.direction: Implement a 165-second simulated-annealing search initialized from `sol_0000`: use `restarts=48`, allow `n∈[12,32]`, and mutate by replacing, adding, or deleting one element within `[-128,128]`, scoring exact enumerated sum/difference sets. Use `T0=0.01`, exponential cooling to `1e-6`, retain the global best, and write it after every improvement plus a final safety write.
